# Heat Illness, Cold Stress & Wildfire Smoke Training

> Heat Illness, Cold Stress & Wildfire Smoke Training: 5 self-paced online courses from $47.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [Cal/OSHA Heat Illness Prevention Training (General Industry)](https://heat-cold-wildfire.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-673): $47.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months.
